volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

inputGain.tooltip: Drive into the limiter before detect/GR. Raise to hit Threshold harder (more pump).

threshold.tooltip: Level where gain reduction starts. Lower = more compression/pump on typical program.

ratio.tooltip: How hard GR climbs above Threshold. ~4–8 = firm. ~12–20 = heavy pump.

lookaheadEnabled.tooltip: How early the detector hears the hit. The audio is delayed by this much, and Attack uses that head start. Off = gain moves on the sample itself.

lookaheadMs.tooltip: Look-ahead delay in ms when Look-ahead is On. Part of the sound (not host-compensated).

lookaheadSamples.tooltip: Extra look-ahead in samples (added to LA Time). Hidden by default.

attack.tooltip: How long gain takes to finish falling after a hit is seen. If this is shorter than Look-ahead, the fall finishes before the hit plays and the output stays at Threshold. If this is longer, the hit can still poke through.

hold.tooltip: How long gain reduction is held after it stops deepening, before Release starts. A new peak restarts the hold. 0 = release right away.

release.tooltip: How fast gain recovers after a hit — the main pump/breathe timing. Longer = slower swell back.

amplitude.tooltip: Final output trim after GR. 0…1. Lower if the bus is too hot; no autogain.

aa.tooltip: Antialiasing. Off is the raw clip. ADAA1 uses the previous sample. ADAA2 uses two previous samples and falls back when the input is flat.

drive.tooltip: Input push into the soft-knee curve.

threshold.tooltip: Amplitude (0...1) where limiting starts. Below this the driven signal is unchanged.

knee.tooltip: How gradual the transition from Threshold toward full scale is. 0 = hard at Threshold.

position.tooltip: Where the pass starts, 0…1 across the face. Drawing wraps to the left and stops when it returns to this line.
